description: This file defines the TreeHash class used for creating a tree hash from streamed data, specifically for AWS Glacier integration. It implements HashInterface and provides methods for updating data, adding checksums, completing the hash calculation, and resetting the state.

classes.name: TreeHash
classes.description: A class that encapsulates the creation of a tree hash from streamed data, used in AWS Glacier for data integrity verification.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the TreeHash with an optional hashing algorithm, defaulting to sha256, and resets the internal state.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Buffers incoming data and creates checksums for chunks larger than 1MB.

methods.name: addChecksum
methods.description: Adds a checksum directly to the tree hash, with an option to specify if the checksum is in binary form.

methods.name: complete
methods.description: Finalizes the hash calculation by processing remaining data and combining checksums into a root hash.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the internal state of the TreeHash object.
